examples.knowledge_point: Evaluating the Definite Integral of an Exponential Function
examples.worked_solution:
Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{5}{e}^{x}\,\text{d}x & ={e}^{x}{|}_{0}^{5} \\  & ={e}^{5}-{e}^{0} \\  & ={e}^{5}-1.\end{aligned}
$$
